We don’t know for sure, but we are confident your power chewer will lather you with kisses for treating them to a Redbarn Filled Bone. Once the filling is licked away, feel free to keep the bone and refill it with your own fillings, like peanut butter from the pantry!

Finally, we hand-fill every bone through a proprietary process, allowing our original Filled Bones to stay semi-moist and perfectly placed, adhering to bone walls instead of carpets.
